verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents multi-currency business accounts that can receive cash in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD, and an MCP tool to review company accounts and balances. Nothing in the pack shows a finance lead viewing account and routing numbers or generating a bank verification letter on demand, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime
